description: A rust-red long noble tunic or coat with ornate gold trim along the high collar, front, cuffs and hem, layered over a cream shirt visible at the wrists and lower hem. A broad brown shoulder mantle is fastened by two round metal brooches linked with a short chain; its edges have rich gold geometric borders. A narrow decorated waist belt has a round buckle and long hanging ornamental end. Brown fitted trousers and brown ankle boots complete the clothing. Textiles look substantial and patterned; exact fibre composition is uncertain. No headgear or weapons appear.
